record: Agency for Cultural Affairs 2026 designation summary
facts: The main building is a long, staggered two-storey timber and partly brick hotel with a central carriage entrance, dining and residential wings.
The historic main building has two guest floors and contains reception, the main restaurant, tea lounge and guest rooms.

record: Hotel operator’s statement on the 2026 main building reopening
facts: The historic main building and 1984 west wing are distinct. The main building retains its historic appearance.
